top_signals.title: Fed-Treasury ‘Regime Change’ May Fuel Bond Rally, Citrini Says
top_signals.summary: The Treasury Department and Federal Reserve are moving toward a more coordinated approach that could shift government borrowing toward shorter-term debt and reduce the supply of longer-dated Treasuries, setting the stage for a rally in 30-year bonds, according to Citrini Research.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Sweden to Donate 10 Coast Guard Vessels to Ukraine

top_signals.title: Thailand Accelerates Clean Energy Push to Cut LNG Dependence
top_signals.summary: Thailand plans to accelerate the rollout of renewable energy sources and embrace nuclear power for the first time to cut reliance on imported LNG in the wake of the Middle East crisis, Energy Minister Akanat Promphan told Bloomberg in an interview published on Thursday. Thailand relies on natural gas for more than 60% of its electricity generation and has become increasingly dependent on imported LNG. Following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, the Southeast Asian country is now looking to bolster its energy security and become less dependent…

Commission endorses Greece's €4.8 billion Social Climate Plan to support vulnerable households, transport users and micro-enterprises in the clean transition
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 27 Aug 2026 Today, the European Commission adopted Greece's Social Climate Plan. It is the fifth and largest national plan adopted under the Social Climate Fund so far, which will use the revenues from emission allowances to advance the clean transition and support vulnerable consumers and enterprises.
